column1: # Reference words: labels that make a number a business number, not personal data
# (order, invoice, tracking ...). Format in pl/references.tsv. French puts "n°" between the
# word and the number ("Facture n° 4400"); the shared pattern does not know that sign, so
# the French rules add it themselves (rules.py, ``_reference_before``, LAB-1785).
# Only words already in the NER check's list (detect/ner_numbers.py ``_NEGATIVE``) are read
# by the NER check; the others are scoped to the rules check until that list takes new
